A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IPVRM and DistRL research. Their text, equations, six figures, fourteen tables and Appendices A–G are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reward-model evaluations, downstream policy experiments, ablations, sensitivity analyses and computational measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains original reward-model and policy results, ablations, sensitivity analyses and computational measurements, with several numerical revisions.

M1.justification: The prefix-value loss, candidate-token TD updates, sampled-token GAE branch, combined objective and ADB/DLW mechanisms remain unchanged. Sections 3.1–3.2 clarify their operation without changing the procedures or objectives.

E1.justification: Section 4.1 changes reported policy-evaluation coverage from AIME 2024 to AIME 2022–2024. Other training and evaluation datasets remain represented. The newly specified OlympiadBench subset is a clarification, without evidence of a different subset being used previously.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: Q-RM, EndoRM, DPO-RM and Implicit PRM for reward evaluation, and GRPO, PRIME, SPRO and Reinforce with Q-RM for policy evaluation. Newly cited works are not added experimental comparators.

E3.justification: The stated AIME test setting changes from the 2024 edition to 2022–2024, limiting direct comparability of its scores; the PDFs do not establish whether experiments were rerun. Training settings and scoring procedures otherwise remain unchanged. Newly stated decoding parameters and subset details are disclosures.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the temporal-weighting ablations, TD-versus-outcome analysis, reward-model/optimizer comparisons, online balancing ablations, reference-choice experiment, hyperparameter sensitivities and ProcessBench scoring comparison. No new analytical question or robustness test is introduced.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains dataloader seed 42 and the statement that other seeds were not configured. Table 13 retains the same timing uncertainty reports. No repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Figure 2 changes DPO-RM with GRPO from 13.5 to 14.0, matching the policy tables. Tables 5–6 change Qwen3-0.6B GRPO/IPVRM AMC from 13.8 to 13.9, alongside other small revisions. Table 14 corrects the process-level DPO-RM average from 27.8 to 28.1. AIME changes accompany revised coverage, rather than demonstrating same-setting performance changes; the main rankings remain stable.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives, advantage definitions, reference-policy derivation and normalization equations are retained. Explaining the normalized sigmoid as the correctness probability clarifies the existing formulation; no new theorem, proof or substantive derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The central IPVRM and DistRL contributions remain. However, v1's conclusion says alignment ensures reasoning-logic verification rather than surface-pattern fitting; v2 replaces this assurance with empirical localization/reranking findings and the more qualified claim that outcome supervision provides useful process signals.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly qualifies the critique as concerning what log-ratios are trained to represent, rather than declaring the parameterization intrinsically unsuitable. It also clarifies the normalized-sigmoid probability interpretation. Existing limitations concerning outcome-label noise, verifiable tasks and TD's weak relationship to long-horizon returns remain.

D1.justification: v2 adds an implementation-access link in the abstract. Section 4.1 newly specifies eight evaluation responses, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95 and the 675-problem English text-only OlympiadBench subset. These improve documentation without establishing changes to previously used settings.

R1.justification: Appendix A expands discussion of entropy and exploration, intrinsic/test-time rewards and retrieval-based verification, adding six cited works. The RLOO and VAPO citations disappear. These broaden the context while retaining the central positioning around inexpensive, refreshable process supervision.

P1.justification: The abstract, substantial portions of the introduction, method explanations, benchmark description, related work and conclusion are rewritten or expanded. This is extensive narrative revision despite the retained section hierarchy and scientific framework. Affiliation, correspondence and publication-header information also change.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is revised and relocated, with altered annotation placement. Existing figures and tables shift with text reflow, several AIME headers lose the 2024 qualifier, and appendix table sizing changes. Five figure contents remain identical; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reproducibility documentation, explains the supervision mismatch more clearly and tempers v1's assurance of reasoning-logic verification. Figure 2 and Table 14 also fix numerical inconsistencies. These are limited gains because the substantive evidence is largely retained. Reporting remains imperfect: the new introduction lists BoN baseline values in the opposite order to its preceding DPO-RM/Implicit PRM labels and Table 1.
